tool_args.rationale: The open-branch observation adds one useful constraint, but the six points still leave competing nonlinear sink mechanisms identifiable only weakly. The trajectory batch can provide additional constraints before committing to a numerical model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the recalled supercritical siphon law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed gradients are below its stated activation range, and six observations do not establish whether that law or another sink-gradient mechanism governs the data.
The observed joint variation in substrate and gradient does not yet distinguish these families reliably from a layered sink mechanism.
It is not targeted at the structural ambiguity.
